About the Internship

Example Corp interns join a small analytics team and own a project from day one. You will scope the question with your manager, pull and model the data, and present a recommendation to the leadership team at the end of the summer.

What You Will Do

  • Create dashboards that the sales and support teams use every week.
  • Document your work so the next analyst can pick it up.

Who You Are

  • A student graduating between December 2027 and June 2028.
  • Comfortable in SQL and spreadsheets; Python is a plus.
  • Legally able to work in the United States without sponsorship for the internship.
